bagPolicy.summary: Standard-size school backpacks are allowed. Small and large luggage are not allowed inside the venue.
prohibited: Bags larger than a standard school backpack
bagPolicy.note: The luggage ban is part of France's Vigipirate security measures. Prohibited items cannot be left at the cloakroom.
